full.description: This is a gross pathology specimen photograph of the liver and associated vascular structures. The image shows a dark, congested liver section with thrombosis or hemorrhagic involvement within the adjacent portal vein or surrounding vessels. The findings are characteristic of hepatic portal vein thrombosis. The specimen provides a clear macroscopic view of vascular occlusion affecting the liver parenchyma.

The image displays a tumor mass located in the hilum along with large metastatic nodules throughout the splenic parenchyma. These findings are most consistent with metastatic colon carcinoma involving the spleen.

random.description: This is a gross pathology specimen photograph showing a section of the liver and associated blood vessels or structures. The image reveals dark, congested, and hemorrhagic tissue, indicative of vascular compromise or thrombosis within the hepatic circulation. Such findings are typically associated with conditions like hepatic vein thrombosis, also known as Budd-Chiari syndrome, or severe hemorrhagic infarction of the liver. The cut surface of the liver demonstrates significant congestion, consistent with impaired venous outflow.
